signup.heading: Set up your practice portal
signup.lede: One screen. When you finish, your practice has a portal on its own address — client intake, maps, notes, agreements, messages — and you are signed in as its owner.

youGet.heading: What you walk away with
items: A portal on your own address, live the moment you finish.
Client intake, the map your clients see, session notes, agreements and messages.
Your practice name on it, not ours.
A founding-partner referral code to hand to the next practitioner.
